text: Install a skill collection from a GitHub repo with a single npx command
quote: npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills

text: Generate and pipe a skill's prompt directly into an agent (e.g. piping to claude) for immediate use
quote: npx skills use vercel-labs/agent-skills@web-design-guidelines | claude

text: `skills use` resolves sources like `skills add` but writes files to a temp dir and prints only the generated prompt to stdout
quote: `skills use` resolves sources the same way as `skills add`, writes the selected skill files to a temporary directory, and prints only the generated prompt to stdout

text: Install only specific named skills from a repo instead of the whole bundle (or '*' for all)
quote: Install specific skills by name (use `'*'` for all skills)

text: Target specific coding agents when installing (e.g. claude-code, codex)
quote: Target specific agents (e.g., `claude-code`, `codex`)

text: List available skills in a repo without installing them
quote: List available skills without installing

text: Install skills to a user-global directory instead of the project
quote: Install to user directory instead of project

text: Non-interactive installation flag suitable for CI/CD pipelines
quote: Non-interactive installation (CI/CD friendly)

text: Same install command works for public and private repos using existing configured auth
quote: Use the same command for public and private repositories. The CLI uses the authentication already configured for the repository URL

text: List all installed skills, similar to `npm ls`
quote: List all installed skills. Similar to `npm ls`.

text: Search for skills interactively or by keyword
quote: Search for skills interactively or by keyword

text: Search for skills across every repository owned by an org or user
quote: Search across every repository owned by an organization or user

text: Update installed skills to their latest versions
quote: Update installed skills to latest versions

text: Remove installed skills from agents cleanly
quote: Remove installed skills from agents

text: Create a new SKILL.md template via a scaffolding command
quote: Create a new SKILL.md template

text: A skill can be built once and reused across any skills-compatible agent
quote: Cross-product reuse: Build a skill once and use it across any skills-compatible agent.

text: Installs create symlinks from each agent to one canonical skill copy, giving a single source of truth for updates
quote: Creates symlinks from each agent to a canonical copy. Single source of truth, easy updates.

text: Install a skill directly from a raw SKILL.md file or archive download URL
quote: npx skills add https://example.com/download/my-skill

text: Project-scoped install location committed with the repo and shared with the team by default
quote: **Project** | (default) | `./<agent>/skills/` | Committed with your project, shared with team

text: Officially supports OpenCode, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and 73+ other agents
quote: Supports **OpenCode**, **Claude Code**, **Codex**, **Cursor**, and [73 more](#supported-agents).

text: `skills experimental_install` restores a team's exact skill set from a skills-lock.json file
quote: `skills experimental_install` | Restore skills from skills-lock.json

text: Agents load only each skill's name and description at startup, loading full content only when relevant
quote: At startup, agents load only the name and description of each available skill, just enough to know when it might be relevant.

text: A validator command checks a skill folder against the skill spec
quote: skills-ref validate ./my-skill

text: A public Skills Leaderboard lets you discover popular skills
quote: Skills Leaderboard

text: Update a single named skill without updating everything else
quote:
npx skills update

# Update a single skill by name
npx skills update my-skill

text: Remove a specific skill from a specific agent by name
quote: npx skills remove --agent claude-code cursor my-skill
